how_it_is_fast: The lock is a 32-bit word taken with an atomic compare-and-swap in user space, and it only calls into the kernel when there is contention. DispatchQueue.sync adds queue bookkeeping, and in the Swift 3/4 era it also heap-allocated the closure context because the call crosses into libdispatch and cannot be inlined. The lock hands ownership to an arbitrary waiter instead of keeping FIFO order, so it skips fairness bookkeeping.
